page.layout: One page of text; running head at top centre; a closing line "EX" at right below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.l: be neficio illi concefsum eft, tam eruditis & fanctis
ita etiam à tota posteritate exaudiatur ad mundi
vsque dissolutionem, quum videlicet Deum vi-
debimus qualis est,æternùm cum ipso victuri &
regnaturi. Quod vt ita fit, faxit idem Dominus.

page.notes: The running head is set in small capitals with spaced letters; rendered as printed. The closing "EX" is a printer's signature line at the right. Some ink spots and show-through are not transcribed. "Genevæ" is read as "Geneuæ" in the scan; given as printed with the visible letters.
